Brunch
Feb 2026 • Friends
The food was the highlight. Everything tasted fresh and thoughtfully prepared, with well-balanced flavours rather than anything overly heavy or gimmicky. The menu offers a good mix of comforting classics and lighter options, so it works whether you’re stopping in for brunch, lunch, or dinner. The coffee was also excellent — smooth, aromatic, and clearly made by someone who cares about what they’re serving.

Service was attentive and friendly throughout. Staff checked in at the right moments without hovering, and there was a genuine sense that they wanted guests to enjoy their time there.
